confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors come from aggregated crowdsourced indexes found by search (Numbeo via Expatica, Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere). I converted them to USD at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.16, which I did not check. No restaurant or bar cocktail average was found for Naples. The cocktail price is based on a single Expatistan figure of about €8 for a downtown club, adjusted upward. The wine-by-the-glass price is estimated from the local price of a bottle of wine and from the beer price. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge for July peak season. I did not search for or inspect any accommodation listings, so they are the least certain anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Naples-specific cost-of-living indexes. Naples is somewhat cheaper than Rome for restaurants, and accommodation is scaled from other southern Italian tourist cities in peak summer.
